findings.claim: The unattended experiment protocol lacks a rule for interactive Spec Kit clarification, so runs can stall or receive inconsistent assistance across arms.
findings.evidence: §7.2 says experiments "run unattended", and §7.1 budgets "None during runs" for owner time. The PR-R1-003 amendment declares rendering-failure handling but no clarification policy or run deadline. Spec Kit v1.0.6 specify explicitly instructs the agent to "Wait for user to respond with their choices" when clarification markers remain ([command source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/github/spec-kit/v1.0.6/templates/commands/specify.md)). Fixed input requirements do not guarantee that both arms generate no clarification questions.
findings.suggested_fix: Before A-measure, declare a common clarification policy and finite run deadline in the experiment manifest. Specify whether clarification requests terminate the attempt or receive predetermined answers, record every intervention, and apply the same policy to both arms.
